title: PLACEHOLDER – Healthcare support worker
entry_route_no_quals: Apply for entry-level support roles where training is given on the job, and complete the Care Certificate in your first weeks.
entry_route_gcse: Apply for healthcare support worker roles, or start a level 2 healthcare support apprenticeship with a local NHS trust.
entry_route_level3: Apply for senior healthcare support roles, or an assistant practitioner apprenticeship that builds on your Level 3.
entry_route_graduate: Apply for healthcare support roles as a first step, then look at graduate-entry nursing or allied health courses.
entry_route_career_changer: Move across with your existing experience: apply for support roles, and take a short care course to fill any gaps.

title: PLACEHOLDER – Social care worker
entry_route_no_quals: Apply for care assistant jobs where employers train you on the job and support you towards a Level 2 diploma.
entry_route_gcse: Start as a care assistant, or a level 2 adult care apprenticeship, and progress to senior care roles.
entry_route_level3: Complete a Level 3 diploma in adult care, which includes an unpaid placement of about 100 hours, then apply for care worker roles.
entry_route_graduate: Apply for care worker or support worker roles; a degree in a related subject can speed up a move into coordinator posts.
entry_route_career_changer: Use your work experience to apply for care roles directly; employers often value maturity and reliability.

title: PLACEHOLDER – Junior software developer
entry_route_no_quals: Start with a free online coding course, build a small portfolio and apply for trainee IT roles; this is a longer route.
entry_route_gcse: Take a level 3 software development apprenticeship, or a coding bootcamp, then apply for junior developer roles.
entry_route_level3: Apply for a degree apprenticeship in software development, or junior developer roles, building a portfolio alongside.
entry_route_graduate: Apply for graduate software developer schemes, or a funded conversion course if your degree is in a different subject.
entry_route_career_changer: Take a funded coding bootcamp while you work, build a portfolio from a real project and apply for junior developer roles.

title: PLACEHOLDER – Data analyst
entry_route_no_quals: Learn spreadsheets and data analysis on free courses, then apply for admin or data entry roles that lead to analyst posts; this is a longer route.
entry_route_gcse: Start with a data or business administration apprenticeship and progress to a data analyst role.
entry_route_level3: Apply for a level 4 data analyst apprenticeship, building on your Level 3.
entry_route_graduate: Apply directly for junior data analyst roles; a short data analysis course can close any gaps.
entry_route_career_changer: Bring your industry knowledge to a data role: add a short spreadsheet and data analysis course, then apply for analyst posts in your sector.

title: PLACEHOLDER – Engineering technician
entry_route_no_quals: Apply for an engineering or manufacturing operative role with training on site, then work towards a technician apprenticeship.
entry_route_gcse: Start a level 3 engineering technician apprenticeship with a North East manufacturer.
entry_route_level3: Apply for engineering technician roles or a higher apprenticeship; your Level 3 meets most employers' entry requirements.
entry_route_graduate: Apply for graduate technician or trainee engineer roles; a short technical drawing course can help.
entry_route_career_changer: Use your transferable skills to apply for technician roles; employers often fund training for good candidates.

title: PLACEHOLDER – Manufacturing team leader
entry_route_no_quals: Join a factory team as an operative, learn on the job and step up to team leader as you gain experience; this is a longer route.
entry_route_gcse: Apply for a team leader apprenticeship, or start as an operative and be promoted as you gain experience.
entry_route_level3: Apply for a team leader or supervisor apprenticeship, or junior supervisor roles.
entry_route_graduate: Apply for a manufacturing management trainee scheme or a team leader role.
entry_route_career_changer: Apply for team leader roles directly using your supervisory experience; a short project management course can help.
